name: growth-archive
description: 以时间轴为主线的个人 / 孩子 / 宠物成长档案

scripts.dev: npm -w @growth/shared run build && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:shared"
scripts.build: npm -w @growth/shared run build && npm -w @growth/web run build && npm -w @growth/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @growth/shared run typecheck && npm -w @growth/server run typecheck && npm -w @growth/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w @growth/shared run test && npm -w @growth/server run test && npm -w @growth/web run typecheck
